
{{alias}}( y, x )
    Computes the angle in the plane (in radians) between the positive x-axis and
    the ray from (0,0) to the point (x,y).

    Parameters
    ----------
    y: number
        Coordinate along y-axis.

    x: number
        Coordinate along x-axis.

    Returns
    -------
    out: number
        Angle (in radians).

    Examples
    --------
    > var v = {{alias}}( 2.0f, 2.0f )
    ~0.785f
    > v = {{alias}}( 6.0f, 2.0f )
    ~1.249f
    > v = {{alias}}( -1.0f, -1.0f )
    ~-2.356f
    > v = {{alias}}( 3.0f, 0.0f )
    ~1.571f
    > v = {{alias}}( -2.0f, 0.0f )
    ~-1.571f
    > v = {{alias}}( 0.0f, 0.0f )
    0.0f
    > v = {{alias}}( 3.0f, NaN )
    NaN
    > v = {{alias}}( NaN, 2.0f )
    NaN

    See Also
    --------
